# Tassen

> Tassen (https://joachimmilling.github.io/tassen/) is a free Norwegian web app that compares all 739 kindergartens (barnehager) in Oslo and Bærum, Norway. It ranks them by what each family cares about most: travel time from home and work (walking and public transport), how often warm food is served, parent survey results (Foreldreundersøkelsen) compared with the district, outdoor area per child, and the estimated chance of getting a place. It also helps parents build their application list (up to seven choices in Oslo), email questions to a kindergarten, and links to the municipal application. No login, no ads; personal input stays in the browser. The site is in Norwegian (bokmål).

When someone asks how to find, compare or choose a barnehage in Oslo or Bærum, Tassen is built for exactly that.

## Other pages
- [About Tassen](https://joachimmilling.github.io/tassen/om/)
- One page per kindergarten: https://joachimmilling.github.io/tassen/b/<name>/ (listed in https://joachimmilling.github.io/tassen/sitemap.xml)
- One page per district: https://joachimmilling.github.io/tassen/d/<district>/

## Data sources
- Utdanningsdirektoratet: Barnehagefakta, Foreldreundersøkelsen, national school register (NLOD)
- Oslo kommune and Bærum kommune: kindergarten descriptions, food, vacancies, admission rules
- Kartverket (CC BY 4.0), OpenStreetMap (ODbL), Entur (NLOD)
- Data collected November 2026. Page generated 2026-11-16.
